A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the chatbot user experience is a multi-faceted construct that is influenced by a range of attributes and that the relative importance of these attributes may vary between different user groups.
the chatbot user experience is a complex phenomenon, and that it is important to take a broad perspective that includes both hedonic and pragmatic attributes.
pragmatic attributes are important for chatbot user experiences, whereas hedonic attributes may be more important for chatbots in particular domains, e.g. entertainment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the user experience with chatbots is a multifaceted experience that includes both pragmatic and hedonic elements.
the pragmatic and hedonic dimensions of user experiences with chatbots are intertwined and should not be considered separately when designing, evaluating, and improving chatbots.
